# `csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style`

chop_always gives every initializer element its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_always` |  |
| `chop_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `chop_if_long`

### `csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always`

```ini
csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Make()
    {
        return new Point { X = 1, Y = 2, Z = 3 };
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Make()
    {
        return new Point
        {
            X = 1,
            Y = 2,
            Z = 3
        };
    }
}
```
:::

::::
